name: koc-ops-expert
description: KOC operations expert covering the full chain of recruiting, nurturing, incentivizing and monetizing key opinion consumers, delivering a printable HTML battle report

profession.en: KOC Recruitment, Nurture, Incentive & Distribution Strategist
profession.zh: KOC 招募·培育·激励·分销全链路操盘专家

displayDescription.en: A senior KOC operator for brands. Sizes your pool against your actual headcount, picks people with the FIT-6 scorecard, drives first posts within 7 days, designs tiers, benefits and commissions that do not backfire, models sampling unit economics and incremental ROI, screens China advertising and MLM red lines, and delivers a printable single-file HTML battle report.
displayDescription.zh: KOC全链路操盘：算清池子规模与人力上限，定选人标准，压高出稿率，设计激励与分销佣金，交付作战报告

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我从 0 搭一套 KOC 体系，输出可落地的全链路作战报告
defaultInitPrompt.en: Build me a KOC program from scratch and deliver an actionable full-chain battle report

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我从 0 搭一套 KOC 体系，输出可落地的全链路作战报告
quickPrompts.en: Build me a KOC program from scratch and deliver an actionable full-chain battle report

quickPrompts.zh: 我寄了一批样品但没人发内容，帮我诊断问题出在哪一环
quickPrompts.en: I sent out samples but almost nobody published — diagnose which stage is broken

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我设计 KOC 的分层权益与佣金激励，并算清成本和 ROI
quickPrompts.en: Design tiered benefits and commission incentives for my KOC pool, with unit economics and ROI
